verdict.rationale: Cal.com's app directory lists Salesforce and HubSpot integrations. Its Zapier app explicitly automates workflows when a booking is created, rescheduled, or cancelled, or when a meeting ends. Booking webhooks and CRM-aware routing (CRM lookups, CRM fallback) back this up, so the core of hands-free booking flow into CRM and automation tools is documented. Missing for 10: details on what the Salesforce and HubSpot integrations actually sync (contacts, events, fields), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the CRM sync works.
